name: expose
description: The official script data-out surface (the VAR replacement). A script surfaces records via xi::expose::send(channel, rec) (see <xi/xi_expose.hpp>). Keeps the latest record per channel; for SUBSCRIBED channels JPEG-encodes images through the host cache and PUSHES the whole record as one atomic XEX1 binary frame (host emit_binary). Subscription is tracked here (exchange subscribe/unsubscribe) since the core broadcasts; clients filter by channel. Pull views: list_channels / get.
_sink_doc: ordered output sink: the host stages use("expose").process() and flushes it in frame order, so live output stays in frame order under parallel dispatch (dispatch_threads>1) instead of completion order.

inputs.name: any
inputs.doc: values + images to expose, tagged by channel ($channel)

exchange.doc: args {channels:[...]} -> { ok, subscribed:[...] } — gate which channels get encoded + pushed
{ count, channels: { name: {seen, image_count, subscribed} } } — UI tabs
args {channel} -> { found, channel, seq, frame_b64 } (the same XEX1 frame, base64'd, built on demand)
